h100-2gpu-ulysses-speed-compile.description: Hopper 2-GPU Ulysses/SP (sequence-parallel), resident + torch.compile — measured fastest for qwen no-CFG.
h100-2gpu-ulysses-speed-compile.policy_exception: Measured H100 e2e ABAB x3 (idle node, single_e2e) 2026-07-03: Ulysses 4.892s vs best-TP 5.135s (-4.7%, 3/3 pairs), vs vLLM 5.17 -> 1.06x. Lossless same-precision-class: TP-vs-Ulysses output MAE 0.74/255 eager (2.27 with compile), MAE DECREASES with steps (3.41->0.74 over 1->30) = convergent FP-reorder from the all-to-all, NOT a bug (TP-vs-TP floor MAE=0.0). Ulysses beats TP because qwen 1024^2 is comm-heavy and SP all-to-all < TP all-reduce; for flux1/zimage TP still wins (Ulysses +4.7%/+8%), so this is per-model.
h100-2gpu-ulysses-speed-compile.notes: Validated H100 only. --enable-cfg-parallel false required (no-CFG single branch; also prevents speed-mode auto-cfg from overriding sp_degree, PR #30016).

h200-2gpu-tp-speed-compile.description: Hopper 2-GPU TP SGLang qwen_image_2512_t2i_1024: resident DiT + torch.compile (best-lossless). Same validated command as flux1/flux2 speed-compile.
h200-2gpu-tp-speed-compile.sglang_ref: origin/main + PR #29774 (QwenImage TP shard) + selective txt_mlp ReplicatedLinear (proposed #29774 follow-up)
h200-2gpu-tp-speed-compile.notes: no-CFG single-branch: TP shard (#29774) but keep text-branch txt_mlp ReplicatedLinear to skip its per-block all-reduce. Measured H100: full-shard 5.65s -> txt_mlp-replicated 5.076s, beats vLLM 5.17s. (true-CFG uses CFG-parallel instead — see the truecfg case.) offload-during-compile is in main. Selective-shard qwen_image.py kept at reports/h100x4-final-20260702/qwen_image_selective_shard.py. H100 superseded by Ulysses profile (measured faster); TP retained for H200 until Ulysses is validated there.
